knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the customer buys the session outcome, with certainty that the visit will be organised and safe. Equipment, the hourly rate or the business age are not what the offer sells.
The lesson says a guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford. Open-ended, impossible or limited-audience guarantees do not meet that test.
The lesson says a claim about a condition or result needs evidence that supports it and checked rules. An endorsement, a discount or no evidence does not meet that standard.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
